E2-2021-T4-P1-S1.trunk: 并列复句：We're good at judging people..., and deliberation can be extraneous and intrusive（我们擅长凭短暂经验判断人，而深思可能多余且有干扰）
structure: 分句①：We're fairly good at judging people based on first impressions
└ 同位解释：thin slices of experience
└ 现在分词短语：ranging from a glimpse of a photo to five-minute interaction
并列分句(and)：deliberation can be not only extraneous but intrusive
E2-2021-T4-P1-S1.logic: 前半句定义基于“薄片经验”的判断，后半句用 not only...but...提出核心观点：刻意思考不但没必要，还可能妨碍判断。
notes: be good at doing：擅长做某事。
thin slices of experience：极短的经验片段。
not only extraneous but intrusive：不仅多余，而且会造成干扰。

E2-2021-T4-P1-S8.trunk: S+V+O从句：Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on cues rather than letting signals form an impression（安巴迪怀疑深思让人关注线索，而非形成整体印象）
structure: └ 宾语从句(that)：deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues
├ 举例：such as certain gestures or utterances
└ 对比结构(rather than)：rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression
E2-2021-T4-P1-S8.logic: that 从句说明准确率下降的原因；rather than 对比刻意抓取显眼线索和让细微信号整体作用两种处理方式。
notes: focus somebody on：使某人把注意力集中于。

E2-2021-T4-P1-S16.trunk: S+V+O：people made decisions that were better and more satisfying（人们作出的决定更好且更令人满意）
structure: └ 定语从句(that)：that were both objectively better and more personally satisfying
时间/条件省略结构：when asked to focus on their feelings rather than on details
限制转折：but only if the decision was complex
└ 破折号解释：when they had a lot of information to process
E2-2021-T4-P1-S16.logic: that 说明决定质量，when 交代实验要求；but only if 把直觉优势限制在复杂决策中，破折号再定义何为复杂。
notes: objectively better：在客观标准上更好。
rather than on details：而不是关注细节。
